title: MoE PGI-S 2.0 & PGI-D Report: Chandigarh Tops School Education for 5th Consecutive Year
summary: Chandigarh sole UT/State in 'Uttam-3' category; Meghalaya records sharpest improvement.

blocks.content: Chandigarh sole UT/State in 'Uttam-3' category; Meghalaya records sharpest improvement.

items: State Leader: Chandigarh topped PGI-S 2.0 for 5th straight year (only entity in 'Uttam-3' grade).
Sharpest Improvement: Meghalaya climbed 2 grades to 'Akanshi-1' (score rose from 448 to 525.7).
District Level: 19 districts reached 'Uttam-2' grade (led by 7 from Punjab).
